name: Graphite Luxe
description: Neutral enterprise-grade theme with elegant graphite accents
css_content: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');:root{--primary:#334155;--primary-dark:#1E293B;--primary-darker:#0F172A;--accent:#64748B;--surface:#fff;--surface-alt:#F8FAFC;--text:#0F172A;--muted:#64748B;--border:#E2E8F0;--grad:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--primary) 0%,var(--accent) 100%);}body{font-family:Inter,sans-serif!important;background:var(--surface-alt)!important;color:var(--text)!important}h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6{font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:-.015em;line-height:1.18}.navbar,.main-content .navbar-top{background:#fff!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)!important}.navbar-nav .nav-link{color:var(--text)!important;font-weight:600}.navbar-nav .nav-link.active{background:var(--grad)!important;color:#fff!important;border-radius:.85rem!important}.btn-primary{background:var(--grad)!important;border:0!important;border-radius:.85rem!important;color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(15,23,42,.22)!important}.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}.btn-outline-primary{border-color:var(--primary)!important;color:var(--primary)!important;border-radius:.85rem!important}.btn-outline-primary:hover{background:var(--primary)!important;color:#fff!important}.card{background:#fff!important;border:1px solid var(--border)!important;border-radius:1rem!important;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.05)!important}.card-hover{transition:all .22s ease}.card-hover:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(15,23,42,.11)!important}.form-control,.form-select{border:1px solid var(--border)!important;border-radius:.85rem!important;padding:.68rem .92rem!important}.form-control:focus,.form-select:focus{border-color:#94A3B8!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 .2rem rgba(51,65,85,.14)!important}.nav-pills .nav-link{border:1px solid var(--primary);color:var(--primary)!important;border-radius:.75rem!important}.nav-pills .nav-link.active{background:var(--grad)!important;color:#fff!important;border:0!important}.gradient-wa{background:var(--grad)!important;color:#fff!important}.text-gradient{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}.nav-blur{background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)!important;backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)!important}
